rationale: log_analyzer parses logs, detects anomalies, and extracts structure from log streams; git exposes log as one sub-operation (git.log(n, path)). The bare 'log' is ambiguous. Delegate: log_analyzer keeps 'log' (the generic log-analysis concept); git receives the more specific 'git log' trigger so it is only matched when the user clearly wants VCS history.
actions_taken: Removed bare trigger 'log' from git in ROUTE_REGISTRY.json
Removed trigger entry {pattern:'log', skill:'git'} from TRIGGER_REGISTRY.json
Added trigger 'git log' -> git (functional, 0.8) to TRIGGER_REGISTRY.json
